== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Supreme Chancellor Valorum (V) (AI) (Errata)]] (<code>1281_30ai</code>, AI printing, Virtual Block 8.1), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Players Committee AI card image ([[:File:VB8-L-supremechancellorvalorumai-pre.gif]]) show the original text of [[Supreme Chancellor Valorum (V) (AI)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list, row of the AI card image (VBlock8Type and VMasterType, captures of 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013; [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-07-21 capture]). The card list drops icons; the icons are those of the printed slip.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Agendas: order. May be targeted by Might Of The Republic. Your characters with politics (except Wedge and senators) are deploy -1 and gain [Republic] here. During your turn, may use 1 Force to ▲ a card with 'Valorum', 'governor' or 'political' in lore.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1281_30ai</code>: AI art (Decipher Supreme Chancellor Valorum (AI)), frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 8 set mark, slip number 8, original-title strip, concept credit, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
